description: Read a member's stored Now, Done, About and self-note in one space, with when they were generated. Pass a userId from naumu_list_members. A part is null when nothing is stored for it; state "empty" means there is no shared activity to summarize yet. Refreshing responses contain the stored text. Runs on your own key and returns exactly what you can read on that member's profile page, Now and Done included.
name: naumu_get_member_profile
title: Get Member Profile
